## Description

The small white blood cell (~7–10 µm) of adaptive immunity (T and B cells): a round, dense nucleus
almost fills it, with a thin ring of pale blue cytoplasm in Giemsa staining.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: not seeded in the default drops (inoculate it from the Catalogue).

Prepared plates: `blood_smear`.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A still cell of the `blood_smear` [slide](../../mechanics/prepared-plates-and-tissues.md#fixed-preparations),
flattened against the glass when fixed.
